m: साद m. sitting (on horseback), riding, RV. i, 162, 17
sinking in (of wheels), VarBṛS.
sinking down, exhaustion, weariness, Kāv.; Suśr.
perishing, decay, loss, ruin, Kālid. (cf. comp.)
despondency, despair, Hariv.; Nalod.
purity, clearness, cleanness (cf. प्र-साद), W.
going, motion, MW.
साद , सादन &c. See p. 1139, col. 1.
a: सादः — [सद्-घञ्] 1 Sinking, settling down. --2 Exhaustion, weariness; उदितोरुसादमोतवेपथुमत् Śi. 9. 77. --3 Leanness, thinness, emaciation; शरीरसादादसमग्रभूषणा R. 3. 2. --4 Perishing, decay, loss, destruction, cessation; गतिविभ्रमसादनीरवा R. 8. 58; Nalod. 3. 24. --5 Pain, torment. --6 Clearness, purity. --7 Going, motion.

m: साद—द mfn. (ifc.) destroying, removing, Śiś.
सादद्-योनि mfn. sitting in one's place, RV.
सादक mfn. (fr. Caus.) exhausting, wearying, destroying, MW.
साद—मय mf(ई)n. caused or produced by despair, Nalod.

exhaustion, decay, MW.

s: klI, (sad + svArTe Ric + lyuw .) sadanam । ityamarawIkAyAM BarataH ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 1 । 154 । 28 । “ahameko nayizyAmi tvAmadya yamasAdanam ॥”)
m: सादन mfn. (fr. Caus.) = सादक, Śiś.
सादन m. a text recited when anything is being set down (cf. below), ĀpŚr.
सादन n. causing to sink, wearying, exhausting, destroying, W.
setting down, arranging (of vessels &c.), ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
sinking in (of wheels), VarBṛS.
(= सदन) a seat, house, dwelling, place, home, MBh.; R.; BhP. a vessel, dish, BhP.
a: सादनं — 1 Wearying, fatiguing. --2 Destroying. --3 Exhaustion. --4 A house, dwelling. --नी Exhaustion, decay, fatigue.

m: सादन—स्पृश् mfn. ‘home-touching’, brought or coming into any one's house, RV.
सादन्य mfn. belonging to a house, domestic, RV.
सादर mf(आ)n. having or showing respect, respectful, reverential
considerate, attentive or devoted to (ifc.), intent upon (अम्, ind. ‘respectfully’ &c.), Kāv.; Kathās. &c.
सादरम् ind., ‘respectfully’ &c.
सादर—पूर्वकम् ind. with respect, respectfully, reverentially, Pañcar.
सादस mfn. being in the Sadas, Lāṭy.
सादसत mfn. containing the words सत् and अस, g. विमुक्तादि.
सादयितव्य mfn. (fr. Caus.) to be destroyed, destructible, R.
साद्दाल (?) m. a palace (v.l. साट्टाल), Bhadrab.
सादेय्य w.r. for सोदर्य, MBh.
सादृशी f. = सादृश्य, Śiś.
सादृशीय mfn. (fr. स-दृत) g. क्रिशाश्वादि.
सादृश mfn. = स-दृश, like, similar, ŚāṅkhŚr.
proper, Divyāv.

v: na॰ sadfSasya BAvaH zyaY । tadBinnatve sati tadgataBUyoDarmarUpe upamAnaDarme । tacca sAdfSyaM saptapadArTAtiriktaH padArTa iti mImAMsakAH । tanmatamuktaM muktAvalyAM “sAdfSyamatiriktaH padArTa iti mImAMsakAH” । tanmataYca upamAnacintAmaRO nirAkftam upamAnaSabde 1235 dfSyam । sAdfSyavAcakA ivAdinipAtAH padfSAdi SabdASca tatra ivAdiBiH nipAtEH sAdfSyasyABiDAne pratiyogyanuyoginoH samAnaviBaktikatvaM, gOriva gavaya candramiva muKaM vaSyatItyAdi । anye tu gavAdiSabdA eva gosadfSe lAkzaRikAH ivAdiSabdAstaTAlakzaRAyAM tatparyyagrAhakA ityAhuH tulopamABinnanAmnA tasyABiDAne pratiyIgini tftIyA zazWI ca । tulopamAByAM yoge tu zazWyeva । sAdfSye ca ekasya pratiyogitA'nyastAnuyogitA tatra pratiyogina upamAnatvamanuyogina upameyatvamiti । upamAnopameyaBAvasya dvayoH samBave'pi prasidDasyevopramAnatA । tatra kAvye kezAdvistUnAM kutracidupamAnatayA varRanaM yuktaM tannirRItaM kavikalpalatAryA yaTA “veRyAH sarpAdiBfNgAlyaH keSazASasya cAmaraH । nIlaRWakalApo'pi, Dammillasya viDuntudaH । sImantasya cADvadaRqO lalAwasvAzwamI viDuH । makaraSca, kapolasya candraH syAt mukuraH sTalI । BruvoH KaqgaDanuryazwI resvApallavallayaH । dfSaScakorahariRamadirAKaYjanAYjanam । kumudaM nIlamagBAjaM, SruterdIpaH sapASakaH । nAsAyAH syustu vaMSADomuKatURIracaYcavaH । tilaprasUnadaRqO cADarasya navapallavaH । vimbIPalaM pravAlaM ca, dantAnAM mOktikvAvaliH । kundadAqimavIjAni hIrakASca, smitasya ca । jyotsnA puzpARi pIyUzaM, SvAsasyAmBojasOraBam । jihvAyAScOqralole ca vARyA BfNgApakaDvanI । vIRAvAdyaM maDu suDA, muKasya candramAstaTA । amBojadarpaRO cApi civuke darpaRAgrakam । kaRWasya kambUrasasya kumBo vAhvostu vallarI । mfRAlalaharISAKApASAH, pARitalasya tu । pallavaScANgulInAM tu pallavI'mBojapatrakam । dIpo navadalaM cEva cambakaM, naKasantateH । ratnatArendupuzpARi, stanayoH kudmalO GawO । kumBikumBO girI cakrO bilve, maDyasya vedikA । siMhamaDyaM vajramaDyaM kzIRadravyaYca kaTyate । upamAnAni romAlyAH reKASevAlavallayaH । nIlakAntamaRIDUmalatAdviradaSuRqakAH । nABeramBojamAvartto hrado vivarakUpakO । tribalyA vIcisopAnaniHSreRyo, jaGanasya tu । pulinaM pIWaPalake, nitambasya sTalaM punaH । parvataH pfTivI sTUlopalaM vastu ca yanmahat । UrvoH kadalikAstamBeBakaro karaBastaTA । jaNGAdvayasya stamBaSca pAdasya navapallavaH । amBojaM ca gaterhaMsaKaYjanadvidatAM gatiH । imAnyanyAnyapi strIRAM puMsAmapi samAni tu । pu so rUpopamAnAnAM viSezaH ko'pi kaTyate । skanDasya vAjivfzaBaskanDO bAhvora hISvaraH । hastihastastaTA stamBArgaladaRqASca, vakzasaH । SilApawwakapAwe ca pramattAkzagatirgateH । yaSasaH kundacandrAdyAH SuBravarRAstaTA matAH । pratApasyAgnisUryyO ca vAqavAgnI razeH karaH । javApuzpAdayaScEva raktavarRapadArTakAH । puRyasya gOrvfkzavIjaM saskAro'Nkura eva ca । SuklavarRAH padATAM ve te'pyatra parikIrttitAH । sAmarTyasya mahadvastu paYcAsyavikramAdikam । nIterlatAdiH sADvIstrI jvAlA dIpasya kIrttitA । AdeSasyotkawecCAdirvedavAkyaM gurorvacaH । SAsanasya sTirArTASca prAranDakarma kIrttitam । pApasya kardamo'kIrttiH kalaNkaH kfzRavarRakaH । anDakAraH keSamasopragftiScopamAnakam । akItteH kfzRavastUni mAlinyaM tamasAM tatiH । kastUrikAyA Bramaro nIlakAnta maRirGanaH । suganDidravyadAhotTaDUmaH kajjalakaM taTA । kfzRapuzpapraBftayaH kAmAkIrttiH sTalAntare । kAminorayaSastadvat kajjalasyApi tAni ca । karpUrasya taTA candraH SaSANkAkaraRastaTA । yUTikAkundakusumaM virahigaRqakastaTA । hiRqIrapiRqaH praTita upamAnatayA Bavi । manoraTasya vijYeyaH PalapuzpAdiyuktaruH । kavibudDikalpanA syAdAnandasya suDArRavaH । brahmasAkza tkftistadvat, kaminIdarSanasya tu । atipriyatamaprAptirbrahmasAkzAtkftistaTA । suDAraso nityasuKasAkzAtkArastaTA mataH । pUrRacandrAdikasyApi sAkzAtkAraH prakIrttitaH । amftasya tu satkAvyaM kAminyaDarapAnakam । vrahmasAkzAtkftistadvat, vizasyAGa prakIrtyate । sADvIstrI virahaH pApaM malinaM duHKadaM ca yat । grIzmAgniH SItakAlInaSItodaM parikIrttitam । vyaBicAriRI ca yA nArI sApi tadvat prakIrttitA । virahasyAgnirADiSca yAtanA ca prayoniDiH । du KadAni ca vastUni taptAni kaTitAni ca । puzpARAM kAminI candraH karpUraYca yaSastaSA । candrasya pramadAvaktramatiSuBraYca yadBavet । yaSaH puRyAdikaM vastu copamAnatayezyate । sUryyasya SivanetrAgniH kAYcanakzmAruhastaTA । bAqabAgnirjavApuzpaM vasantotTapalASakaH । padmasya kAminIvaktvaM pAwala raktavastu ca । indIvarasya kastUrI nIlakAntamaRistaTA । kAminInayanaM tadvat kEravasya tu candramAH । kundAdipuzpamanyacca SuBravarRaYca yadBavet । rAjYa indraH kuveraSca candramA BAskarastaTA । nalapraBftayo ye tu prasidDAScakravarttinaH । meGaMsya kAlI kfzRaSca nIlapATojasaMhatiH । indIvaraM vanaM dAtA kfzRArTo BramarAvalI । SaranmeDasya candrAdiSuklavarRapadArTakAH । kandarpasya nalaScandra ASvinO ca purUravAH । dIpasyarziScampakaYca pratApaH SAstrakaM taTA । vAyoH SIGragavastUni kIrttitAni purAtanEH । aSvasya vAyurhariRo manaSca, hastino giriH । meDastamAlavfkzaSca tamasAYca samucayaH । sODasyoccEHSravAScandraH kElAsErAvatO matO । Sivasya sODavat sarvaM kfzRasya sajalI GanaH tamAlavfkzo BramaraSreRIndIvarakaM naBaH । nIlakAntamaRirnIlapadmaM rAmasya pUrvavat । navadUrvAdalaM vfkzapallavaM cADikam punaH । lakzmyAstu pArvatI candrakAntiH sItA ratistaTA । drOpadI padmakAntiSca purAREH parikIrttitA । sarasvatyAScandrakalA kElAsAcalakAntayaH । SuklavarRapadArTASca, vipaRestu samudrakaH । brahmARqaM paRqitamanastaTA nArAyaRodaram । samudrasya ca meGAdi vastu kfzRaM ca yadBavet । vidUrakzmA BArataYca taTApasmArirogavAn । purasya svargaH kElAso yat vfhat syAt manoramam । raTasya pfTvI vEkuRWapurI potaSca puzpakam । kAminyAstu taqittArA svarRavarRA ca
